canopy: C_e: sampled predicted-tree fraction in a 20 m-wide corridor, along-path sample interval <=8 m, seven cross-section offsets. Raster is actual 2022 NAIP Restor TCD class output. Tree adjacency is not measured time-specific shade.
heat: H_e: existing 0–1 block surface-heat context, attenuated by nearby canopy deficit; not air temperature or a calibrated thermal model.
traffic: Q_e: existing 0–1 nearby mapped traffic burden.
preference: Coefficient 6 and square exponent intentionally prioritize tree-adjacent walks, requested by the project owner. Not learned or validated human preference/medical risk. Travel time remains additive and all weights are nonnegative.

illustrative_50_vs_20_test.status: Synthetic preference test; not a measured Plano pair.

limits: A stronger preference does not guarantee a route is shaded or safe. Road-centerline geometry, model transfer, entrances and crossings need validation. Unrestricted long trips can remain extent-sensitive.
